_: Every capability requested across today's specifications. Status is COMPUTED by libs/research/completion_ledger.py against the working tree, never asserted. A ledger listing only what exists would report 100% and measure nothing, so the unbuilt items are rows here from the moment they are requested.

capabilities.title: Kill audit / nine rejection states
capabilities.economic_reason: 750 of 762 cells died at one gate; a counter cannot distinguish a correct gate from one destroying real alpha silently

capabilities.title: Survivor -> portfolio contribution
capabilities.economic_reason: PORTFOLIO_CONTRIBUTING was unmeasurable, not merely unmeasured: survivor pnl never left the sweep

capabilities.title: Effective independent observations replace calendar gates
capabilities.economic_reason: An edge real for 20 days that spends 15 in a calendar gate has lost most of its economic life to its own validator

capabilities.title: Alpha state machine incl. LIVE_CANARY
capabilities.economic_reason: Nothing made DISCOVERED->LIVE impossible; it was merely undone

capabilities.title: Continuous capital competition, age confers no privilege
capabilities.economic_reason: Capital in a strategy whose forward expectation collapsed is the best remaining opportunity being declined, silently, every day

capabilities.title: Gate power / F3 false-negative calibration
capabilities.economic_reason: F3 keeps 100% of stable and ~50% of conditional edges at every effect size; the plateau is arithmetic, not power

capabilities.title: Hash-lock the survival path
capabilities.economic_reason: The desk hash-locked its constitution and left the kill switch protected by prose comments

capabilities.title: Generic published-gap contract
capabilities.economic_reason: A detector written today could not influence tomorrow's priorities until somebody edited the ranker

capabilities.title: Conversion-chain orphan scan
capabilities.economic_reason: The expensive orphans are research objects, not modules: a hypothesis never tested, a survivor never portfolio-tested

capabilities.title: Claude<->GPT difference engine
capabilities.economic_reason: The valuable output of a second intelligence is the difference, not the overlap

capabilities.title: Assumption / contradiction / unknowns ledger
capabilities.economic_reason: A belief with no falsifier is a habit: it survives its own obsolescence

capabilities.title: Failure bands and near-survivor classes
capabilities.economic_reason: Span-blocked and cost-blocked cells both read as 'did not survive' and are spent in different budgets

capabilities.title: Miner / model / prompt economic ROI
capabilities.economic_reason: Volume is a cost, never an output: 100k pages and no survivors is worse than 100 and two

capabilities.title: Cadence vs measured yield
capabilities.economic_reason: Every cadence was chosen rather than measured; an under-run job finds less than it could forever and nothing records it

capabilities.title: Deterministic study process status
capabilities.economic_reason: Process status was a shell expression, so every invocation could get it wrong

capabilities.title: This ledger: capability status computed, not asserted
capabilities.economic_reason: Prose status drifts, cannot be re-checked, and lets 'built' mean whichever stage the writer had in mind

capabilities.title: F3 threshold sensitivity surface
capabilities.economic_reason: A gate sitting on a knife edge changes hundreds of verdicts on a 5% perturbation
capabilities.next_action: sweep justified perturbations, report the stability surface; never pick a threshold because it yields more survivors

capabilities.title: Per-gate ablation and unique-kill attribution
capabilities.economic_reason: A gate whose kills are entirely covered by another is compute and false-negative exposure for no protection
capabilities.next_action: measure unique kills, overlap, planted-edge destruction per gate

capabilities.title: Cluster the 750 F3 kills into archetypes
capabilities.economic_reason: 750 nominal formulas are not 750 independent failure events
capabilities.next_action: cluster retained killed_cells by arm structure, magnitude, sample, regime, family

capabilities.title: Regime-conditioned validation branch
capabilities.economic_reason: F3 makes conditional alpha mathematically impossible to pass ~half the time
capabilities.next_action: require an EX-ANTE observable state before any conditional rescue; every rescue is a new preregistered hypothesis on untouched evidence

capabilities.title: Regime / beta opportunity book
capabilities.economic_reason: Refusing positive beta in a risk-on regime because it is not market-neutral alpha has a real opportunity cost
capabilities.next_action: reuse existing regime modules; estimate posterior state and evaluate alternative beta exposures against cash

capabilities.title: Path-aware drawdown / rebound engine
capabilities.economic_reason: Reaching -8% slowly is not reaching -8% through a liquidation cascade
capabilities.next_action: conditional forward distributions on path shape; kill honestly if the thesis fails

capabilities.title: Capital-inventory-aware deployment policy
capabilities.economic_reason: Deploying now versus retaining optionality for a better future state is a decision problem, not a fixed tranche count
capabilities.next_action: make remaining dry powder a state variable; derive tranche count endogenously

capabilities.title: Trigger dependency / collision control
capabilities.economic_reason: Four triggers firing on one liquidation cascade is one event, not four signals
capabilities.next_action: effective independent trigger count before any sizing

capabilities.title: Cross-sectional momentum / relative-strength book
capabilities.economic_reason: If we want exposure, WHERE it lives is often easier than forecasting direction
capabilities.next_action: build as a competing sleeve; test continuation AND crowded-winner reversal

capabilities.title: Momentum x rebound interaction
capabilities.economic_reason: Strong assets in systemic liquidation may dominate indiscriminate dip buying
capabilities.next_action: conditional surface, treated as a new family not assumed alpha

capabilities.title: Take-profit / exit state engine
capabilities.economic_reason: Accumulation without a modelled exit is half a strategy
capabilities.next_action: E[log W | hold] vs E[log W | reallocate], competing with alternative uses of capital

capabilities.title: Execution opportunity surface
capabilities.economic_reason: A 4bp gross signal may be +2.1bp net only when maker probability is high and adverse selection low
capabilities.next_action: integrate existing queue_fill/maker/TCA/book_walk rather than duplicating

capabilities.title: Operational alpha retention ratio
capabilities.economic_reason: Finding alpha is not enough; measure how much becomes realised money and attribute the leak
capabilities.next_action: realised vs counterfactual-under-intended-behaviour, attributed by defect class

capabilities.title: Alpha / beta / selection / execution P&L attribution
capabilities.economic_reason: Never label bull-market beta as proprietary alpha
capabilities.next_action: decompose every realised P&L; the allocator cannot learn without it

capabilities.title: Monetisation latency regret accounting
capabilities.economic_reason: Unnecessary waiting is an economic defect and nothing charges it
capabilities.next_action: timestamp every stage; estimate decay and missed opportunity per stage

capabilities.title: Real privilege separation for the risk kernel
capabilities.economic_reason: Hash locking is tamper-evident only; an agent with write access can still change the rails
capabilities.external_blocker: OS-level credential and service separation lives on the VPS: a separate risk-service account the research process cannot write to or redeploy. The repo can generate the unit files and permission matrix; applying them is a host action requiring root on the box
capabilities.next_action: generate deployment config + permission matrix here; principal applies on the box

capabilities.title: Lawful public-disclosure intelligence
capabilities.economic_reason: Mandatory disclosures are information the actor was compelled to reveal
capabilities.next_action: ingest with published_at/first_seen/parsed_at; measure the latency curve before assuming any edge survives the delay

capabilities.title: Cross-domain actor / entity action graph
capabilities.economic_reason: Behavioural fingerprints and capital rotation, not identity
capabilities.next_action: explicit identity confidence; unknown stays unknown

capabilities.title: Dependency-aware evidence fusion
capabilities.economic_reason: Five nominal scouts may equal 1.7 independent observations
capabilities.next_action: effective independent evidence count replaces vote counting

capabilities.title: Public strategist change intelligence
capabilities.economic_reason: The CHANGE in a view carries more information than the view
capabilities.next_action: time-versioned claims + source calibration scorecard

capabilities.title: Public strategy semantic compiler
capabilities.economic_reason: One arbitrary encoding of a discretionary rule can falsely kill a real mechanism
capabilities.next_action: interpretation lattice; test the FAMILY not one encoding

capabilities.title: Research DAG / task compiler
capabilities.economic_reason: Results should spawn their own next steps without a human naming the obvious one
capabilities.next_action: dependency-aware nodes with expected value and artifact contracts

capabilities.title: Concurrency economics controller
capabilities.economic_reason: Maximum valuable throughput, not maximum process count
capabilities.next_action: scale while marginal useful throughput rises; idle capacity with work waiting is a defect

capabilities.title: Learned multi-model router
capabilities.economic_reason: Route by measured downstream value, never reputation
capabilities.next_action: track cost/quality/defect-detection/survivor descendants per model x task class

capabilities.title: Ephemeral specialist workers
capabilities.economic_reason: Permanent seats for occasional work is bloat
capabilities.next_action: instantiate, execute, record value, terminate

capabilities.title: Workflow -> capability distillation
capabilities.economic_reason: An LLM doing repetitive deterministic work is cost with no edge
capabilities.next_action: detect repeated traces, compile, benchmark tokens and latency saved

capabilities.title: Experience -> doctrine distillation
capabilities.economic_reason: A lesson that stays in memory recurs
capabilities.next_action: convert recurring lessons into the strongest justified form; measure whether recurrence falls

capabilities.title: Missed-opportunity intelligence
capabilities.economic_reason: Learning only from trades taken hides validator false negatives and allocator timidity
capabilities.next_action: counterfactuals that generate preregistered tests, never retroactive promotion

capabilities.title: Live prequential evaluation
capabilities.economic_reason: Forecast before outcome, scored without rewriting history
capabilities.next_action: store every forecast pre-outcome; maintain calibration curves

capabilities.title: Operator control surface
capabilities.economic_reason: A more sophisticated backend that is harder to observe is not obviously better
capabilities.next_action: one status surface answering what is live/making money/blocked/next

capabilities.title: Autonomous recovery for non-capital-critical failures
capabilities.economic_reason: A stalled collector is silent alpha loss
capabilities.next_action: detect, diagnose, legal fallback, verify, record -- never by weakening validation

capabilities.title: Completion supervisor
capabilities.economic_reason: No completed batch may terminate the programme while solvable items remain
capabilities.next_action: read ledger, pick highest-value unfinished, launch, update, repeat
